visualCharacteristics.structure: optional large figure + caption per item, items separated by vertical dividers
visualCharacteristics.columns: auto by item count (1-4); 3-up on desktop, stacked on mobile

contentPattern: Stat / goal grid (source heroStats). One row per item: cell 1 large figure (e.g. '100%', '22.9%', '~ 100%'), cell 2 caption. Goal statements without figures use a single caption cell. Headings above the grid, dial image and CTA stay as default content. Single-item usage (one big stat) renders centered.
